Name: Which Farm Cave Redux
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Allows you to redo your farm cave choice once per year
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Want the fruit bat cave for the Community Center?  But also want mushrooms for elixir crafting?  But then decide you want to use a [Deluxe Autograbber](https://mods.smapi.io/#Deluxe_Auto-Grabber) to collect all of the fruit for you?  Now you can change your mind once per in game year about which cave setup you want!

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to add the new event and MissCoriel's [Event Repeater](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3642) to repeat it each year.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  [Install Event Repeater](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3642)﻿.

4.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CP] Which Farm Cave Redux' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

5.  Run the game using SMAPI, you're done!
Update log

*   1.2.2 - Hopefully finally fixes poor Demetrius showing up every season

*   1.2.1 - Updates event ID to be in line with community ID guidelines.  Should not repeat until the next spring still.

*   1.2.0 - Updates to new Repeater format.

*   1.1.0 - Adds Chinese translation, kindly provided by [BH199256](https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/55268877-bh199256/)﻿

*   1.0.1 - Hopefully fixes Repeater pack bug where pack will not load

*   1.0.0 - Initial version
Credit goes to [OOxyligen](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1593092)﻿ for the original [What Farm Cave](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1097) mod that inspired this one.  That one is closed source and seemingly abandoned, so I've decided to remake it from scratch!  A tip of the hat also goes to [FoggyWizard](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48380238) for their [Farm Cave Redo](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3047) mod, which is similar to this mod.

Chinese translation done by [BH199256](https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/55268877-bh199256/)!

Thanks to the SDV Discord #modding crew for proofreading with me, and [MissCoriel](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3946892) for checking that I had the right event conditions.

If you like my mods, please consider checking out my [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/minervamaga)﻿ or [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/U7U69L0R)﻿!
